# DataSynth

**AI-Powered Synthetic Data Generation Platform**

DataSynth is a full-stack platform for generating synthetic datasets across **tabular**, **text**, and **image** modalities using state-of-the-art AI models.

## ✨ Features

- **Multi-Modal Generation** — Tabular (CTGAN/TVAE), Text (OpenAI/Anthropic/Groq), Image (Stable Diffusion)
- **Async Workers** — Celery with modality-specific queues (`queue_tabular`, `queue_text`, `queue_image`)
- **Quality Metrics** — KS-Test, Chi-squared for tabular; token stats for text
- **Real-Time Updates** — WebSocket + React Query polling on the dashboard
- **S3 Storage** — MinIO-backed artifact storage with presigned download URLs
- **Production Ready** — Rate limiting, retry policies, structured logging, Prometheus metrics, Sentry

## 🏗 Architecture

```
Frontend (Next.js) → Backend (FastAPI) → Celery Workers → MinIO (S3)
                          ↕                    ↕
                     PostgreSQL              Redis
```

See [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) for full system design.

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Prerequisites

- Docker & Docker Compose
- (Optional) Node.js 20+, Python 3.11+ for local dev

### Run with Docker

```bash
# 1. Clone and configure
cp infrastructure/env/.env.example .env

# 2. Add your API keys to .env
#    OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...

# 3. Start all services
docker-compose up --build
```

| Service     | URL                          |
|-------------|------------------------------|
| Frontend    | http://localhost:3000         |
| Backend API | http://localhost:8000/api/v1/docs |
| MinIO Console | http://localhost:9001      |
| Prometheus  | http://localhost:8000/metrics |

### Local Development

**Backend:**
```bash
cd backend
pip install -r requirements.txt
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
```

**Frontend:**
```bash
cd frontend
npm install
npm run dev
```

**Celery Worker:**
```bash
cd backend
celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker --loglevel=info -Q queue_tabular,queue_text,queue_image
```

## 📡 API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `POST` | `/api/v1/jobs` | Create generation job |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/jobs` | List jobs (paginated) |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/jobs/{id}` | Get job details |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/jobs/{id}/preview` | Preview generated data |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/jobs/{id}/download` | Presigned download URL |
| `DELETE` | `/api/v1/jobs/{id}` | Delete job + artifacts |
| `WS` | `/ws/jobs` | Real-time status updates |

### Example Request

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/jobs \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "data_type": "tabular",
    "parameters": {
      "columns": [
        {"name": "age", "type": "integer"},
        {"name": "city", "type": "categorical", "values": ["NYC", "LA", "SF"]}
      ],
      "num_rows": 1000,
      "model_type": "ctgan"
    }
  }'
```

## 🧪 Testing

```bash
cd backend
python -m pytest tests/ -v --cov=app
```

## 🔧 Environment Variables

| Variable | Description | Default |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `DATABASE_URL` | PostgreSQL connection (async) | `postgresql+asyncpg://...` |
| `REDIS_URL` | Redis connection | `redis://localhost:6379/0` |
| `S3_ENDPOINT_URL` | MinIO endpoint | `http://localhost:9000` |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | OpenAI API key | — |
| `SENTRY_DSN` | Sentry error tracking | — |
| `RATE_LIMIT` | API rate limit | `20/minute` |

See `infrastructure/env/.env.example` for the full list.

## 📁 Project Structure

```
datasynth/
├── backend/
│   ├── app/
│   │   ├── api/v1/          # Versioned REST + WebSocket endpoints
│   │   ├── core/            # Config, DB, logging, security, metrics
│   │   ├── models/          # SQLAlchemy ORM (Job, Artifact)
│   │   ├── schemas/         # Pydantic validation
│   │   ├── services/        # Business logic layer
│   │   ├── generators/      # AI plugin system (tabular, text, image)
│   │   ├── workers/         # Celery tasks + app config
│   │   ├── storage/         # S3/MinIO client
│   │   └── main.py
│   ├── alembic/             # Database migrations
│   ├── tests/               # pytest test suite
│   └── requirements.txt
├── frontend/
│   ├── app/                 # Next.js pages (landing, create, dashboard, results)
│   ├── components/          # Reusable UI components
│   ├── hooks/               # React Query + WebSocket hooks
│   ├── services/            # API client
│   └── types/               # TypeScript definitions
├── infrastructure/
│   ├── docker/              # Dockerfiles
│   └── env/                 # Environment templates
├── docker-compose.yml
├── ARCHITECTURE.md
└── README.md
```
